# LanternUI 0.10.1 — llms.txt

> Native Phoenix LiveView UI components. Server-rendered HEEx/SVG, themed
> via CSS variables. No React, no JS UI libraries.

## Rules for AI assistants

1. Never switch to React or a JS component library. Build with LanternUI
   components in HEEx.
2. Grouped lists and group headers are banned. One flat list: a status
   column on each row, rows ordered by status then recency, counts in the
   rows or in filter chips. Whatever a group header would have said stays
   visible per row or in the chips.
3. Never hand-roll a table or button element where a component exists:
   table/1, data_table/1, resource_list/1 for tables; button/1
   (size="icon" for icon-only) or dialog action slots for buttons.
4. Never use palette color classes (red-500, slate-200) or hex-in-class
   (bg-[#fff]). Use semantic tokens: text-foreground, -soft, -softest,
   text-muted-foreground, text-danger, bg-success, and friends.
5. Never use arbitrary pixel values (text-[11px], w-[320px]). Dense chrome
   is text-meta (11px), text-caption (12px), text-mono-meta. The
   text-foreground-softer alias is deprecated; use text-foreground-soft.
6. Copy the recipe HEEx below wherever a recipe fits. Never hand-roll
   rows, glyphs, rings, or rails.
7. Page layout: title and actions live in the breadcrumb bar; no tabs as a
   default grouping mechanism; data_table fill only inside a bounded-height
   parent; row click opens the record's own route; disable checkboxes when
   there is no bulk action.
8. Run `mix lantern.lint` on new code. Unknown component or attribute
   names get a did-you-mean hint — trust it over a guess.


## Component catalog

One line per component: name, then when to use it. Deprecated entries name
their replacement. Full attribute tables are in llms-full.txt.

### LanternUI.Charts

- `area_chart/1` — A time-series area + line chart.
- `bar_chart/1` — A categorical bar chart.
- `chart_card/1` — A token-styled chart card for a title, value, caller controls, and chart content.
- `chart_settings/1` — Native server-owned chart controls inside LanternUI's existing Popover.
- `line_chart/1` — A multi-series time-series line chart with a legend and a shared crosshair tooltip.
- `sparkline/1` — A compact trend sparkline (no axes).
- `time_series_chart/1` — Render a generic series-first chart using server-computed SVG geometry.

### LanternUI.Components.Accordion

- `accordion/1` — Accordion — a WAI-ARIA APG accordion with the Fluxon 2.3.1 composition API.
- `accordion_item/1` — Accordion — a WAI-ARIA APG accordion with the Fluxon 2.3.1 composition API.

### LanternUI.Components.ActionBar

- `action_bar/1` — Renders each action inline and in the Zag `More actions` menu.

### LanternUI.Components.Alert

- `alert/1` — Inline status alert.

### LanternUI.Components.AlertDialog

- `alert_dialog/1` — Semantic confirmation dialog composed on the shared modal runtime.

### LanternUI.Components.Autocomplete

- `autocomplete/1` — A Fluxon-compatible autocomplete for static or LiveView-backed search.

### LanternUI.Components.Avatar

- `avatar/1` — Compact initials or fallback-content avatar.

### LanternUI.Components.Badge

- `badge/1` — Status badge / pill.

### LanternUI.Components.Breadcrumb

- `breadcrumb/1` — Compact path breadcrumb — layout chrome + file/tree navigation.

### LanternUI.Components.Button

- `button/1` — Buttons — Fluxon-compatible API, shadcn-caliber styling.
- `button_group/1` — Groups buttons into a single segmented control (shared borders, joined radius).

### LanternUI.Components.Calendar

- `calendar/1` — A month-grid calendar primitive — the pane the date pickers compose.

### LanternUI.Components.Card

- `card/1` — A bounded panel: a titled surface that groups related content on a page.
- `card_grid/1` — A responsive grid of cards.

### LanternUI.Components.Checkbox

- `checkbox/1` — Checkbox with label, description, and error states.

### LanternUI.Components.CiteChip

- `cite_chip/1` — Inline citation button for evidence in prose or attached context.

### LanternUI.Components.CockpitDock

- `cockpit_dock/1` — Render a collapsible right dock that switches between a list and a thread.

### LanternUI.Components.ColorInput

- `color_input/1` — Native color picker paired with a hex readout.

### LanternUI.Components.Command

- `command/1` — Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.
- `command_empty/1` — Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.
- `command_group/1` — Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.
- `command_item/1` — Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.
- `command_separator/1` — Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.
- `command_shortcut/1` — Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.

### LanternUI.Components.DataTable

- `data_table/1` — The admin data table — one Flop-driven table to replace the per-app `admin_table` copies.
- `row_menu/1` — The standard per-row menu for a `:row_action` slot: a ⋮ trigger with an accessible name and a 40px hit target, opening a dropdown of the given items.

### LanternUI.Components.DatePicker

- `date_picker/1` — Date-only picker (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `date_range_picker/1` — Start/end date range, bound to two form fields.
- `date_time_picker/1` — Date + time picker (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmm`).
- `time_picker/1` — Time-only picker (`HH:MM:SS.mmm`, segments only — no popover).

### LanternUI.Components.DateRangePopover

- `date_range_popover/1` — Renders a date range popover with presets and comparison toggling.

### LanternUI.Components.DatetimeField

- `datetime_field/1` — A segmented, directly-editable date/time field — the trigger primitive the date pickers compose (HeroUI-style: `2 / 3 / 2026, 8:45 AM`).

### LanternUI.Components.DescriptionList

- `description_list/1` — Label/value pairs for a record's detail view — the `<dl>` every show page hand-rolls.

### LanternUI.Components.DiffViewer

- `diff_viewer/1` — Line diff of two texts, unified or side by side.

### LanternUI.Components.Dropdown

- `dropdown/1` — Dropdown menu on the shared overlay runtime (anchored placement, focus return, Escape/outside dismissal, arrow-key item navigation).
- `dropdown_button/1` — Dropdown menu on the shared overlay runtime (anchored placement, focus return, Escape/outside dismissal, arrow-key item navigation).
- `dropdown_custom/1` — Dropdown menu on the shared overlay runtime (anchored placement, focus return, Escape/outside dismissal, arrow-key item navigation).
- `dropdown_header/1` — Dropdown menu on the shared overlay runtime (anchored placement, focus return, Escape/outside dismissal, arrow-key item navigation).
- `dropdown_link/1` — Dropdown menu on the shared overlay runtime (anchored placement, focus return, Escape/outside dismissal, arrow-key item navigation).
- `dropdown_separator/1` — Dropdown menu on the shared overlay runtime (anchored placement, focus return, Escape/outside dismissal, arrow-key item navigation).

### LanternUI.Components.EmptyState

- `empty_state/1` — Quiet empty/zero state for tables, lists, and panels (a lantern-ui extension — Fluxon has no equivalent).

### LanternUI.Components.Form

- `error/1` — Form chrome — `label`, `error`, and a Fluxon-compatible `input`.
- `form_actions/1` — The form's action row: right-aligned, cancel then the one primary submit.
- `form_group/1` — A group of related fields: legend, one description line, fields on one gap.
- `input/1` — Form chrome — `label`, `error`, and a Fluxon-compatible `input`.
- `label/1` — Form chrome — `label`, `error`, and a Fluxon-compatible `input`.

### LanternUI.Components.FunnelLine

- `funnel_line/1` — Renders a named line of counted, server-controlled filter buttons.

### LanternUI.Components.HostBadge

- `host_badge/1` — Noninteractive host identity, built on `badge/1`.

### LanternUI.Components.Icon

- `icon/1` — Renders an icon by name.

### LanternUI.Components.IconButton

- `icon_button/1` — Deprecated alias of `LanternUI.Components.Button.button/1` with `label` on an `icon-*` size.

### LanternUI.Components.Inspector

- `inspector/1` — Sticky right-rail inspector: optional section headings and a dense `description_list`.
- `inspector_section/1` — Sticky right-rail inspector: optional section headings and a dense `description_list`.
- `property_row/1` — Sticky right-rail inspector: optional section headings and a dense `description_list`.

### LanternUI.Components.Kbd

- `kbd/1` — Standalone keyboard shortcut hint `<kbd>` component.
- `kbd_group/1` — Standalone keyboard shortcut hint `<kbd>` component.

### LanternUI.Components.Layout

- `app_shell/1` — App shell — a full-width top bar (brand + inline context + actions) over a fixed, collapsible left sidebar and a main content column.
- `breadcrumb_bar/1` — Compact sticky breadcrumb region for use outside `app_shell` (or when the host app still owns the outer shell).
- `nav_group/1` — A labelled group of nav items.
- `nav_item/1` — A sidebar nav item.
- `nav_link/1` — A quiet link for the shell's `:sidebar_footer` — support, docs, legal.
- `page_header/1` — Page title row — compact, goprint-density.
- `page_shell/1` — Page shell with breadcrumb-owned page identity, a visually hidden semantic title, a floating action bar, and the page content region.
- `stack/1` — Vertical stack — one gap for a run of fields, sections, or cards, so a page never depends on margin collapsing or host utilities for its rhythm.

### LanternUI.Components.ListRow

- `list_row/1` — Dense issue/inbox row: leading glyph · muted mono id · truncating title · meta · trailing.

### LanternUI.Components.Loading

- `loading/1` — Inline loading indicator — ring spinner or staggered dots.

### LanternUI.Components.LogView

- `log_line/1` — Log view: monospace lines with a timestamp gutter and per-line severity.
- `log_view/1` — Log view: monospace lines with a timestamp gutter and per-line severity.

### LanternUI.Components.MatrixTable

- `matrix_cell/1` — Environment-by-component grid: rows are things (environments), columns are components, every cell is one state.
- `matrix_row/1` — Environment-by-component grid: rows are things (environments), columns are components, every cell is one state.
- `matrix_table/1` — Environment-by-component grid: rows are things (environments), columns are components, every cell is one state.

### LanternUI.Components.MediaTile

- `media_tile/1` — Renders a generic media tile cell.
- `media_tile_grid/1` — Responsive grid container for `media_tile/1` components.

### LanternUI.Components.Menu

- `menu/1` — Menu button and menubar — no Fluxon equivalent.
- `menu_item/1` — A menu item.
- `menu_separator/1` — Menu button and menubar — no Fluxon equivalent.
- `menubar/1` — Menu button and menubar — no Fluxon equivalent.
- `menubar_menu/1` — Menu button and menubar — no Fluxon equivalent.

### LanternUI.Components.Message

- `message/1` — Chat message rows with optional avatar, metadata, and footer.

### LanternUI.Components.MessageScroller

- `message_scroller/1` — Accessible, follow-aware transcript viewport for chat messages.
- `message_scroller_item/1` — Accessible, follow-aware transcript viewport for chat messages.

### LanternUI.Components.Meter

- `meter/1` — Meter — a scalar measurement within a known range (`role="meter"`, WAI-ARIA APG Meter pattern).

### LanternUI.Components.Modal

- `modal/1` — Modal dialog on the shared overlay runtime (focus trap, Escape/outside dismissal, `prefers-reduced-motion`-aware fade).

### LanternUI.Components.Navlist

- `navheading/1` — A section heading inside a navlist.
- `navlink/1` — A nav list item.
- `navlist/1` — Vertical nav list — heading + links.

### LanternUI.Components.Page

- `detail_layout/1` — Main column plus an optional right rail; the rail is a sibling, not a second page.
- `index_toolbar/1` — One toolbar row: search, view toggle, filters, then actions pushed right.
- `page_container/1` — The page container: left-aligned, named max width, page gutters, one section gap.
- `page_heading/1` — Body heading with an optional lead and the page's primary action.
- `page_section/1` — A titled section for detail pages: small heading, one line of description, content.

### LanternUI.Components.Pagination

- `pagination/1` — Pager + page-size control for paginated collections (a lantern-ui extension; Fluxon has no pagination component — this replaces flop_phoenix's pager).

### LanternUI.Components.Popover

- `popover/1` — Click-triggered floating panel holding arbitrary content.

### LanternUI.Components.PriceGrid

- `price_cell/1` — Renders one priced, selectable cell.
- `price_cell_group/1` — Renders a captioned, wrapping row of price cells.
- `price_grid/1` — Renders a rows x columns table of price cells.

### LanternUI.Components.Progress

- `progress/1` — Progress bar or completion ring.

### LanternUI.Components.ProgressRing

- `progress_ring/1` — Deprecated alias of `LanternUI.Components.Progress.progress/1` with `shape="ring"`.

### LanternUI.Components.ProvenanceBadge

- `provenance_badge/1` — Provenance labels for inherited configuration and temporal retrieval evidence.

### LanternUI.Components.Radio

- `radio/1` — Radio group for exclusive single selection.

### LanternUI.Components.ResourceList

- `resource_list/1` — Resource list: a simple index of resources (projects, apps, databases, buckets).
- `resource_list_item/1` — Resource list: a simple index of resources (projects, apps, databases, buckets).

### LanternUI.Components.ScrollArea

- `scroll_area/1` — ScrollArea — themed scrollbar wrapper around native overflow scrolling.

### LanternUI.Components.Segmented

- `segmented/1` — Deprecated alias of `LanternUI.Components.Tabs.tabs_list/1` with `variant="segmented"`.

### LanternUI.Components.Select

- `select/1` — Select — mirrors Fluxon's `select/1` surface: a `FormField`-aware select with a rich listbox path and a `native` fallback.

### LanternUI.Components.Separator

- `separator/1` — Visual divider — horizontal, vertical, or labeled.

### LanternUI.Components.Settings

- `danger_zone/1` — The last section of a settings page: a `settings_section` whose body is one bordered list of destructive actions.
- `danger_zone_item/1` — One row of a `danger_zone`: title and consequence on the left, the action on the right.
- `settings_form/1` — One independent form as one settings section with ONE Save, disabled until `dirty`.
- `settings_page/1` — Settings page building blocks: a titled page with optional tabs, two-column sections that each save on their own, and a danger zone at the bottom.
- `settings_section/1` — Settings page building blocks: a titled page with optional tabs, two-column sections that each save on their own, and a danger zone at the bottom.

### LanternUI.Components.Sheet

- `sheet/1` — Slide-over panel (drawer) that enters from a screen edge.

### LanternUI.Components.SidePanel

- `side_panel/1` — Collapsible right-hand panel plus a toggle that remembers open/closed in `localStorage`.
- `side_panel_toggle/1` — Collapsible right-hand panel plus a toggle that remembers open/closed in `localStorage`.

### LanternUI.Components.Skeleton

- `skeleton/1` — Decorative, CSS-only placeholder for content that is still loading.

### LanternUI.Components.Slider

- `slider/1` — Slider — a single-thumb range input built on the WAI-ARIA APG slider pattern.

### LanternUI.Components.Sortable

- `drop_zone/1` — The landing area of a `sortable/1` list: dropping here adds to the end.
- `sortable/1` — Drag-and-drop between lists (board columns, bins, groups) and the landing area at the top of each list.

### LanternUI.Components.SplitPane

- `split_pane/1` — Render a horizontal split with a keyboard and pointer resize separator.

### LanternUI.Components.StageStrip

- `stage_strip/1` — Compact, ordered stage pips for a workflow summary.

### LanternUI.Components.Stat

- `stat_card/1` — Renders one compact summary metric.
- `stat_grid/1` — Renders a responsive collection of summary metrics; emits nothing when empty.

### LanternUI.Components.StateGlyph

- `priority_glyph/1` — Flicker-shaped alias of `state_glyph/1` with `kind="priority"`.
- `run_glyph/1` — Flicker-shaped alias of `state_glyph/1` with `kind="run"`.
- `source_glyph/1` — Flicker-shaped alias of `state_glyph/1` with `kind="source"`.
- `state_glyph/1` — Status circles, priority signal bars, run-pipeline, sync, and source glyphs for dense lists.
- `status_glyph/1` — Flicker-shaped alias of `state_glyph/1` with `kind="status"`.
- `sync_glyph/1` — Flicker-shaped alias of `state_glyph/1` with `kind="sync"`.

### LanternUI.Components.Switch

- `switch/1` — Toggle switch for binary settings.

- `tabs/1` — Tabs — segmented tab list + panels.

### LanternUI.Components.TopShell

- `command_trigger/1` — A search field look-alike that opens a `command/1` palette.
- `top_nav_item/1` — A primary link in `top_shell/1`'s `:nav`.
- `top_shell/1` — Top-navigation app shell: a sticky top bar (brand, primary nav, a search slot, actions) over a content column, with no sidebar.

### LanternUI.Components.TopologySvg

- `topology_svg/1` — Server-rendered dependency graph: nodes in columns, labelled edges between them.

### LanternUI.Components.Tree

- `tree/1` — Accessible nested tree for environments and source choosers.
- `tree_item/1` — One node in a tree.

### LanternUI.Components.Waterfall

- `waterfall/1` — Waterfall: horizontal spans laid out on ONE shared time axis, with a ruler.
- `waterfall_lane/1` — Waterfall: horizontal spans laid out on ONE shared time axis, with a ruler.

## Copy-paste recipes

From docs/recipes.md and README.md (same sources the recipe tests render).
Copy these blocks instead of inventing markup.

From `docs/recipes.md` (Media grid):

```heex
<.media_tile_grid min="180px">
  <.media_tile
    :for={item <- @items}
    id={item.id}
    image_src={item.image_url}
    image_alt={item.name}
    selectable
    selected={item.id in @selected_ids}
    on_select="toggle_item"
  >
    <:caption>
      <strong>{item.name}</strong>
      <span>{item.description}</span>
    </:caption>
  </.media_tile>
</.media_tile_grid>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Metric cards with trends):

```heex
<.stat_grid>
  <:stat
    :for={metric <- @metrics}
    id={metric.id}
    label={metric.label}
    value={metric.value}
    subtitle={metric.context}
    tone={metric.tone}
    sparkline_series={metric.history}
    sparkline_label={metric.trend_label}
  />
</.stat_grid>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Date range filter):

```heex
<.date_range_popover
  id="activity-range"
  preset={@range["preset"]}
  start_date={@range["start_date"]}
  end_date={@range["end_date"]}
  today={@today}
  time_zone="Etc/UTC"
  phx-change="range_changed"
/>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Keyboard shortcut hint):

```heex
<.button variant="outline">
  Save
  <.kbd keys={[:command, "S"]} />
</.button>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Linear-style list row):

```heex
<.list_row
  identifier={@ticket.identifier}
  title={@ticket.title}
  parent={@ticket.parent}
  navigate={@ticket.href}
>
  <:leading>
    <.priority_glyph priority={@ticket.priority} />
    <.status_glyph status={@ticket.status} />
  </:leading>
  <:meta>
    <.badge size="sm">{@ticket.tag}</.badge>
    <.progress shape="ring" completed={@ticket.completed} scope={@ticket.scope} size="sm" />
  </:meta>
  <:trailing>{@ticket.date}</:trailing>
</.list_row>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Flat ticket list with toolbar):

```heex
<.data_table
  id="tickets"
  rows={@tickets}
  meta={@meta}
  path="/tickets"
  title="Tickets"
  fill
  views={["list"]}
  show_checkboxes={false}
  search_field={:title}
  data-lantern-list-nav
>
  <:filter
    field={:status}
    label="Status"
    options={[{"In progress (1)", "in_progress"}, {"To do (1)", "todo"}]}
    prompt="All statuses"
  />
  <:list_item :let={ticket}>
    <.list_row
      identifier={ticket.identifier}
      title={ticket.title}
      parent={ticket.parent}
      navigate={ticket.href}
      selected={ticket.selected}
      data-lantern-list-item
    >
      <:leading>
        <.status_glyph status={ticket.status} />
        <span>{ticket.status |> Atom.to_string() |> String.replace("_", " ")}</span>
      </:leading>
      <:meta>
        <.badge size="sm">{ticket.tag}</.badge>
      </:meta>
      <:trailing>{ticket.date}</:trailing>
    </.list_row>
  </:list_item>
</.data_table>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Pinned project bands with shared table/grid sorting):

```heex
<.data_table id="projects" group={[{"Pinned", @pinned}, {"All projects", @others}]}
  meta={@meta} path="/projects" active_view={@view} column_settings={false}>
  <:col :let={row} field={:name} label="Project" sortable>{row.name}</:col>
  <:col :let={row} field={:tickets} label="Tickets" sortable>{row.tickets}</:col>
  <:card :let={row}>{row.name}</:card>
  <:row_action :let={row}>
    <.button id={"pin-#{row.id}"} size="icon-sm" variant="ghost" reveal
      pressed={row.pinned?} label={if row.pinned?, do: "Unpin", else: "Pin"}
      phx-click="pin" phx-value-id={row.id}>
      <.icon name="bookmark" />
    </.button>
  </:row_action>
</.data_table>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Flat table with placeholder row):

```heex
<.data_table
  id="entities"
  rows={@entities}
  meta={@meta}
  path="/entities"
  title="Entities"
  fill
  row_navigate={& &1.href}
  search_field={:name}
  show_checkboxes={false}
>
  <:filter
    field={:kind}
    label="Kind"
    options={[{"Secret (1)", "secret"}, {"Config (1)", "config"}]}
    prompt="All kinds"
  />
  <:col :let={entity} label="Name" field={:name} sortable>{entity.name}</:col>
  <:col :let={entity} label="Kind">{entity.kind}</:col>
  <:col :let={entity} label="Status">
    <.status_glyph status={entity.status} />
    <span>{entity.status |> Atom.to_string() |> String.replace("_", " ")}</span>
  </:col>
  <:card :let={entity}>
    <.list_row identifier={entity.name} title={entity.name} navigate={entity.href}>
      <:leading><.status_glyph status={entity.status} /></:leading>
      <:meta>
        <.badge size="sm">{entity.kind}</.badge>
      </:meta>
    </.list_row>
  </:card>
  <:placeholder label="Add entity" kbd="A" event="add_entity" />
</.data_table>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Record page with inspector rail):

```heex
<.page_shell id="ticket-shell" title={@ticket.title} breadcrumbs={@crumbs}>
  <.card title="Description" description={@ticket.identifier}>
    <:actions>
      <.side_panel_toggle
        id="ticket-panel-toggle"
        panel_id="ticket-panel"
        panel_key="ticket"
        open={@panel_open}
        kbd="]"
      />
    </:actions>
    {@ticket.body}
  </.card>
  <.side_panel id="ticket-panel" open={@panel_open} aria-label="Ticket properties">
    <.inspector aria-label="Ticket">
      <.inspector_section title="Properties">
        <.description_list layout="dense">
          <:item label="Status">{@ticket.status}</:item>
          <:item label="Priority">{@ticket.priority}</:item>
          <:item label="Tags">
            <.badge size="sm">{@ticket.tag}</.badge>
          </:item>
        </.description_list>
      </.inspector_section>
    </.inspector>
  </.side_panel>
</.page_shell>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Three-column inbox):

```heex
<.card_grid>
  <.card flush title={"Inbox · #{@inbox_count}"}>
    <:actions>
      <.button size="icon" variant="ghost" label="Filter" kbd="F">
        <.icon name="funnel" />
      </.button>
    </:actions>
    <.scroll_area label="Inbox" data-lantern-list-nav>
      <.list_row
        :for={item <- @inbox_items}
        identifier={item.identifier}
        title={item.title}
        navigate={item.href}
        selected={item.selected}
        data-lantern-list-item
      >
        <:leading><.status_glyph status={item.status} /></:leading>
        <:meta>
          <.badge size="sm">{item.kind}</.badge>
        </:meta>
      </.list_row>
    </.scroll_area>
  </.card>
  <.card title={@selected.title} description={@selected.meta}>
    {@selected.body}
  </.card>
  <.card flush title="Properties">
    <.inspector aria-label="Suggestion">
      <.inspector_section title="Properties">
        <.description_list layout="dense">
          <:item label="Status">{@selected.status}</:item>
          <:item label="Source">{@selected.source}</:item>
        </.description_list>
      </.inspector_section>
    </.inspector>
  </.card>
</.card_grid>
```

  <.card title={@thread.title} description={@thread.meta}>
    <.message_scroller
      id="thread"

      follow={true}
      busy={@streaming}
      on_seen="seen"
      style="height: 24rem;"
    >
      <.message_scroller_item
        :for={message <- @messages}
        id={"message-#{message.id}"}
        message_id={message.id}
        scroll_anchor={message.role == :assistant}
      >
        <.message
          align={if message.role == :user, do: "end", else: "start"}
          tone={if message.role == :user, do: "primary", else: "surface"}
        >
          <:avatar><.avatar size="sm" initials={message.initials} /></:avatar>
          <:header>{message.author}</:header>
          {message.content}
          <:footer>{message.at}</:footer>
        </.message>
      </.message_scroller_item>
      <.message_scroller_item
        :if={@action}
        id={"action-#{@action.id}"}
        message_id={"action-#{@action.id}"}
      >
        <.card title={@action.title} description={@action.summary}>
          {@action.body}
          <:footer>
            <.button
              id={"action-#{@action.id}-approve"}
              variant="solid"
              phx-click="approve"
              phx-value-id={@action.id}
            >
              Approve
            </.button>
            <.button
              id={"action-#{@action.id}-reject"}
              variant="outline"
              color="danger"
              phx-click="reject"
              phx-value-id={@action.id}
            >
              Reject
            </.button>
          </:footer>
        </.card>
      </.message_scroller_item>
    </.message_scroller>
    <:footer>
      <.stack gap="sm">
        <.alert :if={@send_error} color="danger" title="Message not sent">{@send_error}</.alert>
        <form phx-change="draft" phx-submit="send">
          <.stack gap="sm">

              id="composer"
              name="draft"
              value={@draft}
              label="Message"
              rows={3}

            />
            <.button type="submit" variant="solid" disabled={@streaming}>Send</.button>

    </:footer>
  </.card>
</.card_grid>

        field={:status}
        label="Status"
        options={[
          {"In progress (9)", "in_progress"},

          {"Done (4)", "done"}

        <.stack gap="sm">
          <.alert color="danger" title="Tickets didn't load">
            The request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
          </.alert>
          <div><.button size="sm" variant="outline">Retry</.button></div>
        </.stack>
      </.card>
    </.card_grid>
  </.stack>
</.page_shell>
```

    <.command_item :for={t <- @results} value={t.id}>
      {t.title}

      <:description>{t.project}</:description>
      <:shortcut>⏎</:shortcut>
    </.command_item>
  </.command_group>
  <.command_empty :if={@results == []}>No matches for “{@query}”</.command_empty>
  <:footer>↑↓ to navigate · ⏎ to select</:footer>
</.command>
```

## Go deeper

- `llms-full.txt` — every component with attribute/slot tables, values,
  deprecations, and tokens.
- `mix lantern.lint` — fails on every rule above, with did-you-mean hints.
- `skills/` — lantern-recipes, phoenix-page-design, lantern-migration,
  lantern-ui-components. Install with `mix lantern_ui.install_skills`.
- `docs/UPGRADING.md` — compatibility notes and migration steps from 0.9.x.
- `docs/` — recipes, dense-app, scale (type + grey roles), behaviours.
